title: El Chaltén: hiking at the foot of Fitz Roy
meta_description: El Chaltén guide: trails to Laguna de los Tres and Laguna Torre, when to go, how to get there from El Calafate and where to stay.
hero_subtitle: Argentina's National Trekking Capital, with trails that start right from town.

why_visit.title: Fitz Roy and Cerro Torre
why_visit.text: Two of the most impressive mountains in the Andes, a day's hike from town.

why_visit.title: Trails from town
why_visit.text: You don't need a car or a tour: many trails start in the streets of El Chaltén.

why_visit.title: Lenga forests
why_visit.text: In autumn the forests turn red and yellow and the landscape changes completely.

activities.title: Laguna de los Tres
activities.text: The classic hike to Fitz Roy: a long day with a very steep final section. Start early and pick a clear day.

activities.title: Laguna Torre
activities.text: A full day without big climbs, to a lake with the glacier and Cerro Torre behind it.

activities.title: Mirador de los Cóndores
activities.text: A short walk with views over the town and valley. Ideal for your arrival day or sunset.

activities.title: Loma del Pliegue Tumbado
activities.text: A steady climb to a viewpoint with Fitz Roy, Cerro Torre and Lake Viedma on the same horizon.

activities.title: Lago del Desierto
activities.text: North of town, a day trip among forests, waterfalls and quiet lakes.

how_to_get_there:
The nearest airport is El Calafate (FTE), about 220 km away. There are daily buses to El Chaltén, a trip of around three hours.

By car: via Route 40 and provincial route 23, with steppe scenery and views of Fitz Roy as you approach.

In town: everything is walkable. Stop at the national park visitor center at the entrance for trail information.

where_to_stay.budget: Hostels with shared rooms and guest kitchens, plus campsites in season. They're the most affordable option and a good place to meet other travelers.
where_to_stay.midrange: Inns, cabins and small hotels, often with breakfast included. Cabins with kitchens suit families and groups.
where_to_stay.luxury: Upscale hotels and lodges with landscape views, spas or tours included. Book them well in advance.

practical_tips.title: Best time
practical_tips.text: The trekking season runs from October to April. In winter many lodgings and shops close.

practical_tips.title: Changeable weather
practical_tips.text: Wind and sudden weather changes are part of the trip. Dress in layers and always carry a windbreaker.

practical_tips.title: Book ahead
practical_tips.text: In high season, lodging and tours fill up. It's best to book as soon as you have your dates.

practical_tips.title: Prices and payments
practical_tips.text: Prices change often: check current rates before you travel and carry some cash as well as cards.

closing: Leave spare days: Fitz Roy often hides in the clouds, and the day it clears is your Laguna de los Tres day.
